title: Avro Lancaster PB304
memorial_details: Upright limestone tablet with black inscription. RAF Crest and motto at top centre.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF / A ROYAL AIR FORCE CREW / (NAMES) / WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN LANCASTER PB304 CRASHED / NEAR REGATTA STREET ON JULY 30TH 1944.
custodian: SALFORD CITY COUNCIL AND THE RAF ASSOCIATION
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by Salford City Council And The Raf Association.
duplicate_note: Three site pages exist for Lancaster PB304: salford-pb304 (Agecroft Cemetery, IWM 15977, Comprehensive), avro-lancaster-pb304 (this record — same Agecroft Cemetery memorial, IWM 15977, Partial stub), and crew-of-lancaster-pb304 (St Thomas's Church, IWM 75876 — a different physical memorial). Recommend deprecating avro-lancaster-pb304 and merging its content into salford-pb304. crew-of-lancaster-pb304 is a separate memorial and should be kept. See salford-pb304 for the canonical Agecroft record.
